summary: Iteration 45 — Ask Coach Max compatibility patch for the 4 milestone-based assignment types (60-Second Pitch, 10-Slide Deck, Case Activity, Business Questionnaire). NEW test file /app/backend/tests/test_coach_max_milestone.py (14 tests, 4 classes) verifies: (1) GET /api/submissions/{id} for milestone-based subs returns a synthetic material shape {title, week_number, description, material_type='assignment', submission_type, feedback_template} + raw assignment & milestone at top level; (2) legacy material-based sub still returns real material (regression); (3) 403 for non-owner student, 404 for missing; (4) POST /api/chat/ask-tutor returns 400 for non-sent milestone sub with 'Feedback has not been provided yet', 404 for non-owner, 400 for empty message, and 200 with a real GPT-5.2 response for a sent milestone sub (also verified legacy path); (5) POST /api/submissions/{id}/send-to-student — verified IN-PROCESS by monkeypatching send_email_notification: milestone-based sub → subject contains 'TEST_CMM_60-Second Elevator Pitch - TEST_CMM_Cohort', body contains 'Week 3' (not 'Week ?'), body does NOT default to '>Homework<', CTA anchor href is APP_BASE_URL/coach-max/{sid}. Legacy material-based email regression also verified (subject uses material.title, body has 'Week 1', Coach Max URL present); (6) build_coach_max_context helper accepts week_number kwarg with material=None (milestone-based) and returns (sub_text, ctx_text) — ctx_text contains the Course-Wide global material text ('Leadership framework text: vision, courage, empathy.'); also gracefully returns empty ctx when both material=None and week_number=None. REGRESSION SUITES ALL GREEN: test_submit_on_behalf_milestone.py (13/13), test_assignments_phase2.py (19/19), test_video_submission_review.py (15/15) = 47/47 no regressions. TOTAL: 14 new + 47 regression = 61/61 pass. One code-review bug flagged (below).

minor.issue: Synthetic material's `feedback_template` reads `milestone.get('feedback_template')` (server.py:5066), but the milestone schema stores this as `feedback_template_override` (server.py:826, 2464, 2645). Result: milestone-level feedback template override is NEVER applied — code always falls back to assignment.feedback_template. Should be `(milestone or {}).get('feedback_template_override') or assignment.get('feedback_template')`. Not a crash — just silently ignores the override. Test currently asserts the current (buggy) behavior and flags this comment.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): Fix server.py:5066 — change `milestone.get('feedback_template')` to `milestone.get('feedback_template_override')` so milestone-level overrides actually apply. Currently silently ignored, but doesn't affect the Ask Coach Max flow itself since the frontend uses `material.title` + `material.week_number`, not `feedback_template`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:511-538 `build_coach_max_context` correctly handles both call sites via `wk = (material or {}).get('week_number') if material else week_number`. Uses `$or` on cohort_ids/cohort_id for compat with old materials. Correctly resolves media submission transcripts via `_ensure_submission_transcript` before reading text. Includes global (is_library=True, is_global=True, cohort_ids=<c>) course-wide materials in the loop — verified live.

server.py:3844-3859 `ask_tutor` correctly resolves source: milestone→assignment first, then legacy material fallback. `asgn_title` and `week_number` are set from the assignment/milestone path so the LLM prompt has proper values for milestone-based subs. Prevents the prior KeyError('title') crash on the 4 new assignment types.

server.py:5042-5072 `get_submission` synthetic material shape covers frontend fields (title, week_number, description, material_type, submission_type, feedback_template) so CoachMaxPage.js works without frontend changes. Also exposes raw `assignment` and `milestone` at top level.

server.py:5468-5482 `send_feedback_to_student` correctly prefers milestone-based resolution first (assignment.title + milestone.week_number), falls back to (material.title / 'Homework') + material.week_number / '?'. Fixes the 'Feedback on Your Homework' + 'Week ?' bug for milestone-based subs.

BUG (minor, non-blocking): server.py:5066 uses `milestone.get('feedback_template')` — should be `milestone.get('feedback_template_override')` per the milestone schema (server.py:826, 2464, 2645). Result: milestone-level template override never applied. Same-named field on assignments IS `feedback_template`, so the current code accidentally always falls through to the assignment default. Doesn't break Coach Max chat but silently drops feature. Test asserts current behavior with an in-code comment for main agent.

APP_BASE_URL (server.py:100-110) is resolved from /app/frontend/.env at startup — CTA URL in feedback email is https://cohort-feedback-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/coach-max/{sid} (verified). Works for both legacy and milestone-based subs.
